privacy.title: Privacy Policy & PDPA
privacy.effective: Effective from 1 January 2026 • Compliant with the Personal Data Protection Act B.E. 2562 (PDPA)

s1.heading: 1. Personal data we collect
s1.intro: Movemall collects the personal data necessary to provide our online shopping service, including:

items.label: Identification data:
items.text: Full name, phone number, email address

items.label: Payment data:
items.text: PromptPay transfer slips, transaction records (we never store full credit card numbers on our servers)

items.label: Usage data:
items.text: Order history, saved products, reviews, and cookies used to improve the platform

s2.heading: 2. Why we process your data
items: To process orders and deliver parcels to your address through our shipping partners (Flash Express, Kerry, J&T)
To verify and confirm payments, and to process refunds when there is a problem with an order
To contact you and send live parcel status updates by SMS or push notification
To prevent fraud and keep your account secure

s3.heading: 3. Disclosure to third parties
s3.body: We do not sell or disclose your personal data to third parties, except partners required to provide our service, such as courier companies and payment gateway providers licensed by the Bank of Thailand.

s4.heading: 4. Your rights as a data subject
s4.intro: Under the PDPA, you have the right to:
items: Access and request a copy of your personal data
Request correction of your personal data to keep it accurate and up to date
Request deletion, destruction, or suspension of use of your personal data
Withdraw your consent to data processing
s4.footerPrefix: To exercise these rights, contact our Data Protection Officer (DPO) by email:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.updated: Last updated: 16 August 2026 • Movemall Marketplace Platform

s1.heading: 1. Acceptance of terms
s1.body: By accessing or using the Movemall platform, you confirm that you have read, understood and agree to be bound by these terms and conditions in full. If you do not accept these terms, please discontinue use of the platform.

s2.heading: 2. Your account and security
s2.body: You are responsible for keeping your username and password secure and for all activity that takes place under your account. If you notice any unauthorized access, notify our team immediately.

s3.heading: 3. Orders, payment and delivery
s3.body: An order is considered complete once payment is confirmed (PromptPay / credit card) or once cash-on-delivery (COD) is confirmed as the selected method. Items are shipped to the address on file in your account.

s4.heading: 4. Returns policy and the Movemall Mall guarantee
s4.body: Products under Movemall Mall carry a 100% authenticity guarantee (double refund if found counterfeit), and return requests can be submitted within 30 days of delivery, subject to the stated conditions.

help.heroSubtitle: Find answers, learn how to order, check shipping and return policies, or contact Movemall support

items.q: Does Movemall offer cash on delivery (COD)?
items.a: Yes! Movemall supports cash on delivery (COD), PromptPay/QR transfers, credit/debit cards, and mobile banking from every bank.
Deliveries within Bangkok and surrounding provinces take 1-2 business days; other provinces take 2-3 business days. Next-day Express Delivery is also available.

items.q: How do I exchange or return a product?
items.a: You can request a return within 30 days of delivery from the "Order history" menu, or contact customer support. Items must be in original condition with original packaging.

items.q: How do I become a seller on Movemall?
items.a: Click the "🏪 Seller Centre" button in the top menu to open a store and list products for free, with no sign-up fee.

items.q: How do free-shipping and discount vouchers work?
items.a: Claim discount codes from the voucher centre or a store page. At checkout, the discount is calculated and applied automatically.

order.title: How to order on Movemall
order.subtitle: Shop quality products easily and safely in 4 steps:
order.step1Desc: Search for products or browse categories, and check ratings from real buyers
order.step2Desc: Choose the quantity you want, then tap "Add to cart" or "Buy now"
order.step3Desc: Provide your name, address, phone number, and preferred delivery method
order.step4Desc: Choose a payment method (PromptPay, credit card, or cash on delivery), then confirm your order

returns.title: Returns & Refunds Policy (30-day money back)
returns.guaranteeBody: If your item arrives damaged, defective, or not as ordered, you can return it for a replacement or a full refund at no cost.
